purpose: Outline figures to be prepared for arXiv version (LaTeX) of the qmirror preprint. This file is the source-of-truth for figure intent; actual figures are deferred until LaTeX conversion.

figures.label: Figure 1: qmirror four-tier architecture
figures.caption_draft: Architecture of the qmirror substrate. Tier 0 (HMAC-DRBG SHA-256, NIST SP 800-90A keyed by ANU bytes) is the deterministic regression default; Tier 1 (ANU QRNG keyed REST API) is the live quantum-entropy path; Tier 2 (ANU QRNG keyless legacy endpoint) is the courtesy fallback; Tier 3 (mock LCG) is the CI-deterministic invariance path. Aer (or Cirq) provides exact unitary evolution; the entropy stream feeds CDF inversion at the measurement collapse step. The substitution of pseudo-random Mersenne Twister by ANU bytes (or HMAC-DRBG keyed by ANU) is the only material substrate-honesty change.
figures.suggested_tool: TikZ or draw.io export to PDF

figures.label: Figure 2: Cross-vendor |Delta S| concordance heatmap
figures.caption_draft: Pairwise absolute CHSH-S deviation across four QPU vendors (IonQ Aria-1, IonQ Forte-1, Rigetti Cepheus 108Q, IBM Heron r2 ibm_fez). Single-batch N = 1 measurements, no run-to-run repeats. Color scale: green |Delta S| <= 0.30 (cond.8 letter band), yellow 0.30 < |Delta S| <= 0.55 (cond.7 same-class band), orange 0.55 < |Delta S| <= 0.60 (cond.7 cross-tech revised band), red |Delta S| > 0.60. Bold cells (0.112, 0.084) are the closure load-bearers.
figures.suggested_tool: matplotlib pcolor or seaborn heatmap, exported to PDF

figures.label: Figure 3: Cost-per-CHSH-battery comparison
figures.caption_draft: Per-battery cost (USD, log scale) for a 4-circuit CHSH benchmark across qmirror and four real-QPU vendors. qmirror's cost is the floor (USD 0). Real-QPU costs reflect single-batch observed billing across the closure cycle: IBM Heron r2 USD 3.20 (1024 shots/setting), Rigetti Cepheus USD 2.94 (1024 shots/setting), IonQ Forte-1 USD 33.20 (100 shots/setting), IonQ Aria-1 USD 81.20 (250 shots/setting; reference baseline from prior cycle). Batch-size-normalized cost shown in inset.
figures.suggested_tool: matplotlib bar with log y-axis, exported to PDF

figures.label: Figure 4: Per-condition evidence flow
figures.caption_draft: Evidence flow for the 8 closure conditions. Each condition (cond.1-cond.8) maps to a verifier (jq expression or hexa CLI), an evidence file (state/qmirror_*/verdict.json or selftest_results.json), and a landed handoff doc. Two post-hoc band revisions (cond.3 and cond.7) and one spirit-paper-analysis (cond.7) are highlighted with selection-bias disclosure tags.

figures.label: Figure 5 (optional): Per-correlator E values across vendors
figures.caption_draft: Per-correlator expectation values E(a,b), E(a,b'), E(a',b), E(a',b') across four QPU vendors. Error bars are sigma_E. Demonstrates the canonical antisymmetric pattern (E(a,b'), E(a,b'), E(a',b), E(a',b')) in (+, -, +, +) layout that yields S >= 2.0.
figures.suggested_tool: matplotlib bar with yerr, exported to PDF
